record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: Let (y in Y) -> (x in X) be a finite morphism that is etale in codimension one. Do the Frobenius volume and Hilbert-Kunz Frobenius volume satisfy the finite-degree formulas Fvol(y, Y) = deg(f) Fvol(x, X) and Fvol_HN(y, Y) = deg(f) Fvol_HN(x, X)?

evidence.quote:
Problem 43. Let (y ∈ Y ) → (x ∈ X) be a finite morphism which is ´etale in codimension one.
We have
Fvol(y, Y ) = deg(f) · Fvol(x, X) and FvolHN(y, Y ) = deg(f) · FvolHN(x, X).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic $p>0$, and let $(x \in X)$ be a normal local singularity of finite type over $k$. For a Cartier (or $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier) setup, let $\mathrm{Fvol}(x,X)$ denote the Frobenius volume of $(x \in X)$, defined via the asymptotic behaviour of $\dim_k H^0$-type invariants under iterations of the Frobenius morphism, and let $\mathrm{Fvol}_{HN}(x,X)$ denote the Hilbert–Kunz Frobenius volume, defined analogously using Hilbert–Kunz type asymptotics.

Suppose 
$$f \colon (y \in Y) \longrightarrow (x \in X)$$
is a finite dominant morphism between normal local singularities that is étale in codimension one (i.e. the ramification locus of $f$ has codimension at least two in $Y$). Let $\deg(f)$ denote the degree of the field extension $K(Y)/K(X)$.

Prove or disprove the following finite-degree (multiplicativity) formulas:
$$\mathrm{Fvol}(y,Y) \;=\; \deg(f)\cdot \mathrm{Fvol}(x,X),$$
$$\mathrm{Fvol}_{HN}(y,Y) \;=\; \deg(f)\cdot \mathrm{Fvol}_{HN}(x,X).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent collection of open problems on K-stability of Fano varieties. While analogous transformation/multiplicativity rules under finite covers étale in codimension one are known for F-signature, Hilbert–Kunz multiplicity, and certain limit-multiplicity invariants (work of Carvajal-Rojas–Smolkin–Tucker and others), no published proof of the stated equalities for the Frobenius volume Fvol and Hilbert–Kunz Frobenius volume Fvol_HN was found. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Multiplicities and Hilbert-Kunz multiplicity under étale-in-codimension-one covers
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Hilbert–Kunz density function and Frobenius–Poincaré function with transformation rules under finite covers.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous multiplicativity results exist for F-signature/Hilbert–Kunz multiplicity, but not stated for the Frobenius volume invariants in question.

status_evidence.title: Étale fundamental groups of KLT singularities and F-signature bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds on the local étale fundamental group of KLT singularities via F-signature using transformation under étale-in-codimension-one covers.
status_evidence.claim: Transformation rules for F-invariants under such covers are an active and ongoing topic, supporting the plausibility (but not resolution) of the problem.
